title: Track active Copilot usage with the Microsoft 365 usage report
problem: Management asks if the Copilot investment is used.
steps: Microsoft 365 admin center > Reports > Usage > Microsoft Copilot > Copilot (Usage tab).
Review enabled vs active users, active users rate and adoption by app; data arrives within about 48 hours.
Reallocate licenses from users inactive for 30+ days (after checking with managers).
pitfalls: User names are concealed by default — change it under Settings > Org settings > Services > Reports (Global Administrator).
